method.description: Reconstruct conformal factor and determinant-one conformal metric from ADM spatial metric; use contracted conformal Gamma^i = gamma_tilde^{jk} Gamma_tilde^i_jk in BSSN Ricci formula; independently compare reconstructed scalar Ricci with direct metric Ricci on periodic non-conformally-flat analytic controls and archived snapshots.
method.bug_found_and_fixed: The first reconstruction used Gamma^j_j_i (the connection trace) instead of the BSSN contracted conformal connection gamma_tilde^{jk} Gamma^i_jk. These are different contractions. The contracted connection and Christoffel index placement are now explicit in source.

matter_source_diagnostic.interpretation: Dense-region matter-source normalization is consistent with coefficient one; it does not explain the archived-H mismatch.

archived_native_H_comparison.domain: t=0 and t=128, tl=0, rl=2, trim4
archived_native_H_comparison.interpretation: The corrected independent geometry reconstruction does not make the saved native H agree; the discrepancy remains material.

public_implementation_reference.repository: stevenrbrandt/einsteintoolkit (public mirror of Einstein Toolkit component source)

observations.metric_derived_contracted_connection_is_: line 1752 onward constructs Xtn1/Xtn2/Xtn3 from conformal metric Christoffels
observations.connection_constraint_is_the_difference: line 1901 onward sets cXt_i = Xtn_i - Xt_i
observations.Ricci_curvature_uses_evolved_connection_: line 1761 onward includes JacPDstandardNth1Xt1 etc. in Rt11 and corresponding tensor components
observations.Hamiltonian_expression: line 1899 sets H from trR + 2/3 K^2 - A_ij A^ij - 16 pi rho

public_implementation_reference.scope_caveat: This pinned public source snapshot demonstrates why ML_Gamma is needed for exact native-operator replay if the run uses this implementation. The archived simulation's actual McLachlan/Einstein Toolkit revision and parameters have not been identified, so equivalence to the original runtime is NOT_ESTABLISHED.

archive_inventory.conclusion: The exact native discrete ML_BSSN H operator cannot be independently replayed from this archive: only ADM metric/extrinsic-curvature, matter, and H/M constraint snapshots are present. The pinned public implementation explicitly uses evolved ML_Gamma separately from its metric-derived connection; the missing field is therefore essential for exact replay under that implementation. To close parity, an archived run must emit the conformal BSSN fields and pinned solver/source parameters at matching times.
